A maintenance release: HW Glance now builds on egui 0.37.

## What changed

- The **egui toolkit** is updated from 0.36 to 0.37. The fix for the window freezing while it is out of view on Wayland (on a workspace no monitor shows, or under a fullscreen window), which 0.1.2 carried as a patched copy of eframe, is now part of eframe itself, so the patched copy is gone. The fix behaves the same.
- The contents of the settings window sit about a pixel lower. Nothing else looks different.

The window and the collector speak the same protocol as 0.3.0 (protocol 6). Restart the collector after updating (the step below) so it runs the new build.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance/blob/v0.3.1/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install or update

Arch Linux, from the package attached below:

```sh
sudo pacman -U hwglance-0.3.1-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
systemctl --user restart hwglanced
sudo systemctl restart hwglance-helper   # if you use the optional helper
hwglance-bar-widget update               # Omarchy only, if you installed the widget
```

For a first install, enable the services instead: `systemctl --user enable --now hwglanced` and, optionally, `sudo systemctl enable --now hwglance-helper`, then `hwglance-bar-widget install` on Omarchy.

Other x86_64 Linux distributions, from the tarball (prebuilt, no Rust needed):

```sh
tar -xzf hwglance-0.3.1-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
cd hwglance-0.3.1-x86_64-linux
./install.sh
```

Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. Requirements and optional components are in the [README](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance#what-you-need).
